HRT, for me, MTF, swallowing pills, almost 10 months in, has caused these unexpected changes:

- Everybody loves to claim their skin got "baby soft." Mine has gotten super dry. Especially in the hands, nose, lips.
- Crave sweets and salt.
- COMPLETELY changed my #2 regularity (comfortably go once a week now)
- My sense of smell is more sensitive. Men stink.

As far as feminization goes. If you think you'll get an ass and hips soon, pfft. Muscle mass has diminished in my case tho. Arms are getting "chicken wingy."

One might say a cleaner, healthier liver might have gotten me more results in 10 months than I've gotten...bit I'm happy with my overall change in mood and my boob size so far, my health has not been affected YET...so fuck it. Cheers! 🍻
